title: Cosmological correlators from the Inflation end to CMB sky via reheating
summary: We investigate the imprint of post-inflationary evolution on primordial cosmological correlators by relaxing the standard assumption of instantaneous reheating. We compute the power spectrum and bispectrum for a conformally coupled and non-minimally coupled ($ξ\neq \frac{1}{6},0$) scalar field with cubic self-interaction, across a finite reheating epoch characterized by an effective equation of state $w$, and reheating temperature $T_{\rm reh}$.
